label: For "Flaky Test Detection & Quarantine": Identify and quarantine flaky tests that waste CI time and erode trust, and prioritise fixes by impact. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating all failures as flakiness.
